package_itineraries.title: Arrival in Srinagar & Sunset Shikara on Dal Lake
package_itineraries.description: Meet and greet at Srinagar Airport by our representative. Transfer to your luxury houseboat. Evening relaxing 1-hour shikara ride on Dal Lake passing floating gardens and lotus blossoms.
package_itineraries.activities: Airport pickup, Houseboat check-in, Dal Lake Shikara ride

package_itineraries.title: Mughal Gardens & Historic Srinagar Sightseeing
package_itineraries.description: Visit the world-renowned Mughal terraced gardens: Nishat Bagh (Garden of Pleasure) and Shalimar Bagh (Abode of Love), followed by Chashme Shahi and Shankaracharya Hill temple.
package_itineraries.activities: Sightseeing of Mughal Gardens, Old Srinagar heritage walk

package_itineraries.title: Gulmarg Meadow of Flowers & Gondola Ride
package_itineraries.description: Scenic drive to Gulmarg. Board the famous Gulmarg Gondola up to Kongdoori Phase 1 (elev. 10,000 ft). Enjoy snow views and optional skiing or snowmobiling.
package_itineraries.activities: Gondola ride, snow play, alpine photography

package_itineraries.title: Pahalgam Valley of Shepherds & Lidder River
package_itineraries.description: Drive along saffron fields of Pampore to reach Pahalgam. Visit scenic Betaab Valley where Bollywood movies were filmed, and stroll beside the turquoise Lidder river.
package_itineraries.activities: Saffron field stop, Betaab Valley, Lidder river walk

package_itineraries.title: Aru Valley & Kashmiri Handicrafts Shopping
package_itineraries.description: Explore the unspoiled alpine meadows of Aru Valley. Return to Srinagar for an afternoon visiting authentic Pashmina shawl looms and walnut woodcarving workshops.
package_itineraries.activities: Aru Valley exploration, artisan craft workshops, Wazwan feast

package_itineraries.title: Departure with Cherished Himalayan Memories
package_itineraries.description: After a leisurely breakfast overlooking the water, transfer to Srinagar International Airport for your flight home with unforgettable memories.

package_itineraries.title: Arrival in Male & Seaplane Transfer to Paradise Island
package_itineraries.description: Land at Velana International Airport and board your scenic seaplane flight over sparkling atolls. Check in to your luxury Beach Villa. Welcome tropical cocktail & dinner.
package_itineraries.activities: Seaplane transfer, resort welcome, beach sunset walk

package_itineraries.title: House Reef Snorkeling & Sunset Dolphin Cruise
package_itineraries.description: Swim in warm crystal waters alongside sea turtles and colorful reef fish. In the late afternoon, embark on a traditional Maldivian Dhoni cruise to spot playful spinner dolphins.
package_itineraries.activities: Guided reef snorkeling, sunset dolphin cruise

package_itineraries.title: Water Villa Check-In & Overwater Spa Therapy
package_itineraries.description: Transfer to your iconic Overwater Villa with glass floor panels and direct sea stairs. Enjoy an afternoon couple signature aromatherapeutic massage at the overwater spa.
package_itineraries.activities: Water villa transition, couple spa ritual, private sundeck relaxing

package_itineraries.title: Kayak Safari & Candlelight Beach Dinner
package_itineraries.description: Paddle transparent kayaks across calm lagoons. In the evening, enjoy a private 5-course romantic candlelight dinner on the secluded beach under starlit skies.
package_itineraries.activities: Clear kayak safari, private candlelight dinner

package_itineraries.title: Farewell Maldives & Seaplane Return
package_itineraries.description: Enjoy a leisurely breakfast over the lagoon before your seaplane return transfer to Male for your flight home.
